limitations.note: The patch fixed the counter’s OR-to-AND handshake bug but also removed the downstream-ready condition from the accumulator reload, changing `data_out` when the first input of a group is accepted with `ready_b` low.

The scoreboard assumed the accumulator should restart at every group boundary regardless of `ready_b`, so its backpressure cases confirmed the rewrite instead of catching the change from the reference behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the simulation invocation to be rejected and resubmitted, after an earlier failed `git status` had already forced the source-file read to be retried.
